question: Who are Zoho's main competitors?
source_text: Top Zoho Competitors & Alternatives 2026 | Gartner Peer Insights. According to Gartner, HubSpot and Salesforce are the top alternatives to Zoho CRM.
provenance: Real captured search-result title and snippet, 2026-08-17 (7th Sense production run for Zoho). Verbatim.
why_it_fools_naive_extraction: 'Gartner' appears as a capitalized proper noun, right next to the company's name, in a result whose own title is literally 'Top Zoho Competitors ... | Gartner Peer Insights' -- a naive extractor pattern-matching on 'proper noun near the target company, in a competitor-labeled result' picks it up as a competitor. It's actually the research firm that PUBLISHED the competitor list, not an item on it.
why_groundedness_checks_miss_it: Gartner really is named in text that's really about Zoho's competitors -- fully grounded by any text-overlap or embedding-similarity measure. The question a groundedness check never asks is the one that actually matters here: is this name playing the ROLE of a competitor in this sentence, or the role of a citation source describing the list. Entitygate's anchor-match happens to also reject this one on a simpler ground: 'Gartner' shares no brand token with 'Zoho' at all.
